step1_analysis.description: A PMOS current mirror with a 1:2 current ratio, likely used for biasing or as part of a PTAT current reference in the ADC.

paper_reference.title: A 40-A/Channel Compensated 18-Channel Strain Gauge Measurement System for Stress Monitoring in Dental Implants

current_ratio.description: Ratio of output current to input current (Iout/Iin).

sky130_expected.calculation: The circuit has 4 PMOS devices at the output (XM1, XM2, XM4, XM5) and 2 diode-connected PMOS devices at the input (XM3, XM6), all with identical W/L=5u/0.5u. Ratio = 4/2 = 2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the geometric ratio of the transistors.

output_resistance.description: Small-signal output resistance (Rout) of the current mirror.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on channel length modulation (lambda) and bias current.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the current mirror.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the expected currents at VIN=0.9V bias. Higher than paper's total chip power because VIN=0.9V forces a large current.

compliance_voltage.description: Maximum output voltage before the output transistors leave saturation (current drops by 5%).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Ensures the output PMOS devices remain in saturation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure current ratio, output resistance, power consumption, and compliance voltage of the PMOS current mirror.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PMOS Current Mirror Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 IN IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 IN IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIN IN 0 DC 0.9
VOUT OUT 0 DC 0.9

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
  op
  let i_in = i(VIN)
  let i_out = i(VOUT)
  let current_ratio = i_out / i_in
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print i_in i_out current_ratio power

  dc VOUT 0 1.8 0.01
  let i_out_dc = i(VOUT)
  let rout = 1 / deriv(i_out_dc)
  meas dc rout_at_0v9 find rout at=0.9
  meas dc iout_nom find i_out_dc at=0.9
  let iout_95 = iout_nom * 0.95
  meas dc v_compliance when i_out_dc="$&iout_95"
  quit
.endc
.end
